thig3.4:1.1: divāvihārā nikkhamma Gijjhakūṭamhi pabbate | nāgaṃ ogāha-m-uttiṇṇaṃ nadītīramhi addasaṃ. || ||
thig3.4:2.1: puriso aṅkusam ādāya dehi pādan ti yācati | nāgo pasārayi pādaṃ puriso nāgam āruhi || ||
thig3.4:3.1: disvā adantaṃ damitaṃ manussānaṃ vasaṃ gataṃ | tato cittaṃ samādhemi khalu tāya vanaṃ gatā. || || Dantikā. ||
